audience.programmeDescription: Leiden’s bachelor in Italian Language and Culture combines Italian language study with linguistics, literature, film and cultural history. Teaching is in Dutch and Italian. Its formal language goals are C1 for reading and listening and B2 for speaking and writing. The degree includes research and a bachelor thesis.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The displayed 170 EC is a partial inventory. The remaining 10 EC of distinct third-year choices and a valid sequence through advanced courses and thesis entry still need confirmation. A complete comparison with UCR remains unfinished.

curriculum.limitation: The components shown account for 170 EC. Four options in the third-year choice list also appear in the second year. The remaining 10 EC of distinct options and the entry conditions for several advanced courses and the thesis need confirmation.

componentNotes.curr-component-24: 30 EC of elective space, including an approved minor, exchange or placement. Level and non-overlap rules apply; Honours courses cannot count here. Recognised 30 EC Leiden, Delft and Erasmus minors do not need separate individual approval.
componentNotes.curr-5603vbscry: 10 EC thesis with a required seminar, a supervisor and a second assessor. Entry requires a completed first year and at least 40 EC from the second year, including all language courses. The rules still use earlier language-course names; their current equivalents need confirmation.
componentNotes.curr-5603iclcy: 5 EC listed third-year option in Italian syntax and dialects. Entry requires B1 Italian and prior Italian linguistics or equivalent study.
componentNotes.curr-5602vli2ay: Entry requires completion of Lingua italiana Ia, Ib and Ic under the current programme regulation.
componentNotes.curr-5602vli2by: Entry requires completion of Lingua italiana Ia, Ib and Ic under the current programme regulation.
componentNotes.curr-5603icmsy: Requires a prior pass of at least 5 EC in specified Italian linguistics, language history or sociolinguistics, Italian speaking at B2–C1 and other Italian skills at C1, and oral English at C1. Its listed second-year placement needs confirmation against these entry requirements.
componentNotes.curr-5603iclny: Entry requires B2 written and spoken Italian.
componentNotes.curr-5603iiny: Entry accepts completed Lingua italiana IIa or the earlier Taalvaardigheid IIa and IIb.
